messages:
elaine (eng-release): kicking off sprintwave rollout for service-api v2.4.1 -> target 50% over 30m. change window now. will do stop/go checks at +10m and +20m. tagging @sara @mike @ashley :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: automated rollout started. phase=canary target=10% region=global expected_step_duration=10m. watch: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/service-api/v2.4.1
mike (infra): noted. i'll watch infra p95 and connection_errors. ping me if queuing >5% or p95 > 300ms.
sara (platform): adding loadgen run on eu-west-1 for the 10m window, will post summary at +9.
ashely (sre): typo: ashley here. quick ask — are sticky sessions enabled for this rollout? if not, we should avoid stateful endpoints.
elaine (eng-release): thanks Ashley. service-api v2 is stateless for these endpoints. session affinity disabled.
deploy-bot: rollout progressed to 10% after 2m. metrics: p50=65ms p95=210ms errors=0.9% (baseline errors=0.8%).
mike (infra): seeing slight connection error bump in us-east-1 at +6m: connection_reset spiked to 1.8%. logs: ```2026-03-20T12:06:31Z service-api worker-42 ERROR connection_reset user_req_id=abc123 host=us-east-1```
sara (platform): loadgen summary (eu-west-1) at +9m: throughput +12%, no latency regressions, error rate stable. details: https://logs.internal/abc123
ashley (sre): that us-east spike lines up with a simultaneous infra deploy we had earlier. can we isolate by pinning traffic away from us-east for the next step?
elaine (eng-release): proposal: throttle next step to 20% and exclude us-east-1 until we verify infra mitigation. thoughts? :thinking_face:
mike (infra): +1 to exclude us-east. i'll run a targeted probe and re-check network egress on the nodes. ETA 8m.
ashely (sre): agree. also recommend pinning previous version v2.4.0 on us-east behind routing policy so only stable variant serves there. command to pin: `rbctl pin service-api us-east-1 v2.4.0`
elaine (eng-release): deploy-bot — pause rollout and reroute us-east traffic to v2.4.0, then continue to 20% for other regions.
deploy-bot: received pause command. initiating reroute: routing-rule=exclude-region us-east-1 -> pinned-version=v2.4.0. rolling back canary in us-east.
deploy-bot: rollout resumed to 20% (regions: all except us-east-1). metrics: p95=230ms errors=0.95%
sara (platform): re-run loadgen on eu-west and ap-south at +18m. will report in 5m.
mike (infra): probe results: network egress queued packets temporarily inside us-east router, fixed via route-flap mitigation. 0 dropped now. recommend we keep pinned for 15m then re-evaluate.
ashely (sre): ops checklist: 1) pin v2.4.0 in us-east (done) 2) create rollback snapshot (done) 3) increase observability retention for this rollout (done)
elaine (eng-release): consensus = hold us-east pinned, continue staged rollout at 20% across others, next stop/go at +30m for final 50% decision. action: @mike monitor infra, @sara post loadgen summary, @ashley keep watch on incident channel. I'll create release note blurb and update the change window. :white_check_mark:
sara (platform): loadgen results at +23m: no regression in covered regions. p95 delta <= 10%. recommending proceed to increase after us-east unpin.
mike (infra): will post final infra check at +35m.
ashely (sre): ack. I'll hold the rollback playbook ready in case errors cross 2%.
elaine (eng-release): closing for now — keep thread updated. if anything crosses thresholds, call immediate rollback. :loud_sound:
